generated_output.summary: The maintainer proposes revisiting and disabling default-on tool-call nudging specifically for the external inference loop (`studio/backend/core/inference/studio_tool_loop.py`), by updating `chat-adapter.ts` so the frontend does not send `nudge_tool_calls: true` on the external branch. Extensive measurements show that the nudge feature yields high false-positive rates, unnecessary extra generations, and corrupts conversation shapes (`user -> user` message replaying instead of `user -> assistant -> user`), whereas system-prompt guidance alone successfully handles tool calls without stateful conversation distortion.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The loop-level nudge mechanism (`INTENT_SIGNAL` / `is_short_intent_without_action`) frequently fires false positives on model self-descriptions. When triggered in the external loop, it replays the stall as `user -> user`, rewriting user messages up to four times and hiding the model's previous answer.
